0022600122.text: The Mavericks (1-2, 11th in the West) visit the Heat (0-3, 15th in the East), with Miami on a three-game losing streak and both teams sitting two games back in their divisions. Dallas is missing Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain, 23.0 points per game this season), Kyrie Irving (knee, 19.5 points per game this season), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Caleb Martin (thumb sprain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), all listed as out. The teams have not played yet this season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and Dallas won the last meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
